about: Every reference lap kept for later analysis (what makes the most difference to lap time): time trial world record laps once their event ends or a better one replaces them, and each week's daily race laps before the next week's replace them. Not used by the website. One entry per lap: file (under data/archive/), kind (time trial or daily race), event_id (time trials), track, car (the lap's own car), driver, lap time, the event's dates, when the lap was added, where it was before, and a note.
